title:
The Frohmanian Symplectic Tether and a Conditional Regularity Framework for the 3D Incompressible Navier--Stokes Equations\\[4pt]
\large Complete Original Conjectured Framework and Kernel-Verified Non-Vacuous Conditional Formalization in Lean~4

claims.statement: Let $\nu>0$ and let $u_0$ be smooth (\lean{ContDiff ℝ ⊤}), divergence-free, and of finite $L^2$ energy. Assume within the class of physical solutions (\lean{IsPhysicalNSSolution}): •[(K)] \emph{Kato local existence with uniform restart}: a local smooth physical solution (\lean{KatoLocalWitness}) exists from every such datum, with a restart increment $\tau>0$ extending existence times below $T^*(u_0,\nu)$; •[(R)] \emph{Frohmanian cubic tether rate (\lean{FrohmanianTetherRate})}: along every physical solution from $u_0$, the vorticity sup-norm $t\mapsto M(t)$ is continuous, differentiable on $[0,\infty)$, and satisfies \[ M'(t)\le \CZ\,M(t)^2-\kappa''\,M(t)^3\qquad(t\ge 0) \] for constants $\CZ>0$, $\kappa''>0$ (yielding \lean{FrohmanianTetherBound}); •[(U)] \emph{Physical uniqueness (\lean{huniq})}: smooth physical solutions (\lean{IsPhysicalNSSolution}) starting from $u_0$ agree with the Kato witness on each existence interval $[0,T]$. Then $M(t)\le\max\bigl(M(0),\CZ/\kappa''\bigr)$ for all $t\ge0$, and \eqref{eq:NS} admits a globally defined physical solution $u$ on $[0,\infty)$ that is spatially $C^\infty$ for every $t\ge0$, divergence-free, and unique among all smooth physical solutions.
claims.title: Conditional Global Regularity; \lean{frohmanian_tether_theorem}, \lean{global_regularity_for_NS}; depends on the unresolved premise (R)

claims.statement: For a velocity field $u=\mathrm{BS}(\omega)$ with $\|u\|_{L^2}\neq0$, let $\Pi_u=P^\perp_u$ be the $L^2$-orthogonal Gram--Schmidt projection onto the complement of $\operatorname{span}\{u\}$: \[ \Pi_u v=v-\frac{\langle v,u\rangle_{L^2}}{\|u\|_{L^2}^2}\,u \] (Lean: \lean{ForMathlib.Pi_u}, with $\Pi_u v=v$ when $\|u\|_{L^2}=0$). With universal 3D Calderón--Zygmund constant $\kappa=\CZ(3)=\frac{3}{8\pi}\cdot 4\pi=\frac{3}{2}$ (Lean: \lean{kappa_eq_three_halves} in \lean{ForMathlib/NS/Tether.lean}), define the Frohmanian tether kernel \[ T(F,G)(\omega)=B(F,G)(\omega)=-\kappa\,\|\omega\|_{L^2}^2\int_{\T}\Bigl\langle \Pi_u\Bigl(\frac{\delta F}{\delta\omega}\Bigr)(x),\,\Pi_u\Bigl(\frac{\delta G}{\delta\omega}\Bigr)(x)\Bigr\rangle\,dV , \] where $\|\omega\|_{L^2}^2=\int_{\T}|\omega|^2\,dV$ is the enstrophy (Lean: \lean{Enstrophy}), a constant on each coadjoint orbit. The full tethered bracket is $\{F,G\}_{\Tf}=\{F,G\}_{\mathrm{cl}}+T(F,G)$.
claims.title: Frohmanian tether kernel; Lean \lean{TetherKernel}, \lean{Pi_u}

claims.statement: Whenever $\delta H/\delta\omega=u$, $\nabla\cdot u=0$, and $u\in L^2$, one has $\Pi_u u=0$ (\lean{projection_orthogonal_to_u}) and hence \[ B(F,H)(\omega)=0\qquad\text{for every functional }F. \]
claims.title: Strict Degeneracy on Kinetic Energy; proved, \lean{tetherKernel_degenerates_on_kinetic_energy}

claims.statement: Let $x$ satisfy $\|\omega(x)\|=\|\omega\|_{L^\infty}$ and suppose $\|\nabla u(x)\|\le\CZ\|\omega\|_{L^\infty}$ (\lean{hCZ}). Then \[ \langle\omega(x),(\omega\cdot\nabla)u(x)\rangle\le\CZ\,\|\omega\|_{L^\infty}^3 . \]
claims.title: Stretching at a spatial maximum; proved, \lean{stretching_inner_le_at_max}

claims.statement: Let $C>0$, $\kappa''>0$, and let $y:[0,\infty)\to\R$ be differentiable on $[0,\infty)$ with \[ y'(s)\le C\,y(s)^2-\kappa''\,y(s)^3\qquad(s\ge0). \] Then for every $t\ge0$, \[ y(t)\le\max\Bigl(y(0),\ \frac{C}{\kappa''}\Bigr). \]
claims.title: Cubic comparison stability; proved, \lean{comparison_ode_stability}

claims.statement: For $C,\kappa''>0$ and $y_0\ge0$, any solution $Y_{C,\kappa''}(t;y_0)$ of the comparison ODE $y'=Cy^2-\kappa''y^3$, $y(0)=y_0$ (\lean{ComparisonODE}) satisfies $0\le Y_{C,\kappa''}(t;y_0)\le\max(y_0,C/\kappa'')$ for all $t\ge0$.
claims.title: Explicit majorant global bound; proved, \lean{comparison_majorant_global_bound}

claims.statement: If $M(t)=\|\omega(t)\|_{L^\infty}$ is differentiable on $[0,\infty)$ and satisfies $M'(t)\le \CZ M(t)^2-\kappa''M(t)^3$, then \[ \sup_{t\ge0}M(t)\le\max\Bigl(M(0),\frac{\CZ}{\kappa''}\Bigr). \]
claims.title: Cubic rate $\Rightarrow$ uniform vorticity ceiling; proved implication, \lean{riccati_ceiling_of_vorticity_di}; premise unresolved
